role: In-memory, MainActor @Observable singleton that accumulates per-request LLM token usage (input, output, cache read, cache create) and exposes cumulative/recent/per-provider cache hit ratios for Settings → Troubleshooting → AI cache health; owns the one copy of the hit-ratio formula.
types: LLMCacheTelemetry: final class (@Observable @MainActor) — rolling token counters
LLMCacheTelemetry.Totals: struct — five summed counters, one observation per record
LLMCacheTelemetry.TurnRecord: private struct — one request's usage
toplevel: Singleton `shared`; stored totals = .init(), recent = [], recentCap 50. Not persisted; reset by DataPurgeService.purgeHealthCaches and the diagnostics Reset button.

units.does: Adds one provider request's token counts to totals in a single assignment (so totals.turns counts requests: a turn with tool rounds counts once per round), appends a TurnRecord stamped now to `recent`, and trims `recent` to the newest 50.

branches.effect: drops oldest entries to keep 50; otherwise no trim

flags.text: record() runs once per provider REQUEST (now documented here), but the cache-health card labels totalTurns and the per-provider counts 'Total turns' / 'Turns:', so a turn with 3 tool rounds shows as 3 turns. The card's labels (SettingsPages+Diagnostics) need to say requests, or AssistantViewModel needs to record once per turn (handoff).

units.does: Cumulative hit ratio over all recorded requests: hitRatio(input:cachedRead:cacheCreate:) of the totals; 0 when nothing recorded.
units.entry: read by SwiftUI body of the AI cache health card

units.does: The one hit-ratio formula: cachedRead / (input + cachedRead + cacheCreate), 0 when that total is 0. Input is the uncached part only (every streamer normalises to that), so the total is the whole prompt; dividing by input alone gave >100% values. nonisolated, so callers outside the MainActor class can use it.
Hit ratio over the last `turns` (default 10) records in `recent` via hitRatio(of:); 0 when the slice processed no tokens.
Groups `recent` by provider and returns (provider, request count, hitRatio(of:)) tuples sorted by count descending. Only covers the last 50 requests, not the session.
hitRatio(input:cachedRead:cacheCreate:) over the summed counters of a run of records.
Resets totals to zero and empties `recent`.
